# Mathematical notation

> **这页管什么**：数学符号、变量、指数的写法。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/mathematical-notation> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## Symbols and entities

- Use HTML entities for math symbols rather than keyboard characters, except plus, equals, and division.
- Don't use an asterisk for multiplication; drop the symbol entirely when unambiguous — "ab".

## Operators

- Use `&minus;` instead of a hyphen.
- Add a nonbreaking space on both sides of operators within an expression.
- Don't italicize operators.

## Variables

Italicize variables — *x* ≠ *y*.

## Expressions and equations

- Keep short expressions inline.
- Use nonbreaking spaces so the equation doesn't break awkwardly.
- Move the equation to its own line if a break becomes awkward.

## Fractions

Express as decimals when possible. If written as words, hyphenate — "three-sevenths".

## Exponents and subscripts

- No space between base and exponent.
- Use `<sup>` for exponents — **the caret `^` is not allowed**.
- Use `<sub>` for subscripts.

## Notation vs words

Notation can generally replace words in running text. If it creates ambiguity or hurts readability, use words.

## Complex equations

For multiline or complex equations poorly suited to HTML, use diagrams, images, or a math-rendering tool.
